Name: Aditya Simha
Question: When was the first time you noticed actress Salma Hayek?
Answer: The first movie I saw of Salma Hayek’s was Desperado. After that, I was absolutely a fan of hers, and have continued to be one. I sought out movies in which she was acting - this included From Dusk to Dawn, Fools Rush In, Wild Wild West, Frida, etc. But Desperado continues to be one of my favorite Salma Hayek movies to date - she was fantastically magnificent in it, and the movie is ageless. You can watch it numerous times, and it never appears dated. So, to reiterate, that was the first time I noticed Salma Hayek, and I simply haven’t stopped noticing her since.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: Why don't pretty Indian girls participate in Miss Universe. Why do they only pick the most average looking Indian women to participate?
Answer: Well, one person’s treasure may not necessarily be another person’s treasure. Similarly, most people would have no difficulty in saying that all of the many Indian contestants in all the Miss Universe contests are/were pretty. They are/were not “average” or “ordinary looking” by any means. You may not personally find any of them to be pretty, but I can assure you there are plenty of others who do/did find them pretty. I mean, at the very least, the selection committee found them pretty, right? Anyway, it’s all a matter of personal preference. You obviously have a different standard of beauty, and that’s alright. Just know that your standard is an exceedingly rare one. “They” don’t pick the most “average” Indian women to participate - far from it!

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: How come Bollywood actors and actresses have such an excellent command over the English language?
Answer: Not all Bollywood actors and actresses have an excellent command over the English language. There are doubtless many who do, but there are still many others who don’t. Generally speaking, many of the lot who have gone abroad to study, tend to have a decent command over English, and can converse with ease. And, there are some who were born and raised abroad, and they too tend to be fluent in English. You probably have watched interviews of the folks who are fluent in English. There are several others though who are much more comfortable with other languages rather than English. It doesn’t mean they’re stupid or feeble minded, it’s just that they are better in other languages. If you hear them speak in their native tongues (be it Hindi or Gujarati or Tamil or Bengali, etc.) you’ll see how flawlessly and poetically they speak those tongues. So, I’d say that some are indeed fluent in English, but that doesn’t apply to all Bollywood actors and actresses.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: What actor or actress could be labeled a Hollywood tragedy?
Answer: As per me, the biggest Hollywood tragedy is that of poor LiLo or Lindsay Lohan. She had so much promise, and so much potential, when she initially started. All of that original promise got totally squandered by poor decisions, all brought on by terrible parenting from her parents. They agree with that well deserved blame too. While she did herself take many bad decisions, which all culminated in destroying her career, I think it is fair to blame those decisions on her rather turbulent and somewhat chaotic childhood. If only she hadn’t fallen prey to all those demons and poor decisions, she would have made such a huge impact with her movie career. So, to me, that is a huge Hollywood tragedy.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: Why did the Bollywood top actress Katrina Kaif have to settle with Vicky Kaushal?
Answer: Well, for starters I am truly terribly sorry that Kat did not accept your marriage proposal. But that is surely no reason to spit venom futilely at Vicky Kaushal? Come now, unrequited love and ensuing heartbreak happens to all of us. But we must rise above puerile pettiness. After all, so what, if Kat said no to you and yes to another - there are plenty of felines in the forest. Go out there and bag yourself another Kat in your quest for love. Anyway, keeping aside the matter of your broken heart, you certainly seem to have conveniently ignored all of Vicky Kaushal’s accomplishments. He has consistently given brilliant performances, and has had several huge successes too (Sanju, Uri, Raazi, etc.) Additionally, his star is rising, while Kat’s appears to be setting (as is sadly typical for actresses, above 35). So no, he is not a “low class actor” and she is not “settling”. So, wish them both a happy married life together, and refrain from projecting negative judgments on others. Aim to be positive, unless you’re being tested for some sort of infectious disease.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: Do you find actor Keanu Reeves believable as the paid assassin John Wick or would fellow actor Bruce Willis have been a better choice?
Answer: Indubitably so - Keanu Reeves is absolutely brilliant and believable in the titular role of John Wick. Nobody else could do the role the way Keanu does, least of all Bruce Willis. There are dozens of reasons why Bruce Willis would be the second worst choice of all to play John Wick (the hands down worst choice to play John Wick would be Steven Seagal). But the primary one is that Bruce Willis has completely checked out from his acting career. He acts in movies, but he does with no passion and no interest, and he doesn’t even seem to remember his lines anymore. He is also the worst in terms of doing publicity for his films. If he had done John Wick, the movie would have bombed, and there would be no sequels, because Bruce would have been so damn lazy and unpleasant throughout. Keanu may not be Anthony Hopkins, but he works hard and is an amiable sort of fellow, unlike the perennially grouchy & lazy Bruce Willis. Actually, let me amend my previous point- even Steven Seagal would probably work harder than Bruce Willis at this point. So, Bruce Willis would have been the absolutely worst choice to play John Wick.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: What was your first impression of Monica Bellucci?
Answer: My first impression of Monica Bellucci is one that has barely changed, at least not in any major measurable way. I will still claim that she was and is one of the most beautiful and enchanting models/actresses out there. Her pictures, especially from when she was younger, are still some of my most favorite ones. Such brilliant pulchritude shines through in all of them. Nobody else could do those photoshoots the way she could. So, like I alluded to earlier , my first and immediate impression was, “Whoa! She is just divinely beautiful!”

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: Is Neha Dhupia still an A-list Bollywood actress?
Answer: I would say this answer is a bit of a “it depends” answer. As a primary lead actress, Neha Dhupia could not be said to be an A-list actress. I can only think of two successful movies of hers, where she was a lead actress, or at least one of the lead actresses (Qayamat and Kya Kool Hai Hum). Suffice to stare that that alone cannot make anyone an A-lister. Nowadays, however, she seems to have gotten lots of A-lister friends and connections (KJo etc.), and that keeps her in the news (i.e. the press writes about her in a mostly adulatory way). So, in a way, one could argue that today, she can be considered an A-list supporting actress. Not an A-list lead actress, but definitely more A-list in a supporting actress hierarchy.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: What is the reason Padma Lakshmi did not know the identity of her daughter's father when she was pregnant in 2009?
Answer: At the time she was dating on-and-off two different guys. One was Adam Dell and the other was Teddy Forstmann. Additionally, since she had endometriosis, she had not even thought she could get pregnant. So, for a while after she got pregnant, she just wasn’t sure who the father of the baby was. It was one of the two, but who, she just could not pick with pinpoint precision. After her baby was born, it was finally revealed that Adam Dell was the biological father. She recently spoke about how mortifying all of the incessant and bare media speculation (i.e. about the father of her baby) was during that period.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: What are some must-watch movies of Madhuri Dixit?
Answer: Madhuri Dixit has appeared in some excellent movies in her career. I’ve pretty much grown up watching her movies, and she is still one of my most favorite Bollywood stars. As per me, her best movies are those she did with Anil Kapoor, Sanjay Dutt, Mithun Chakraborty and Sunny Deol. Tezaab is definitely one such film - what a bloody awesome film it was. Other films I would pick are Parinda, Prem Pratigya, Saajan, and Khalnayak. I am sure other people will pick Devdas or Hum Aapke Hai Kaun; but personally I detested those two films. One was overly maudlin while the other was a Barjatya horror show from the deepest crevice of hell. Anyway, those are my picks. There are plenty of other Madhuri Dixit movies which are awesome, but the ones I would consider must-watch are the ones I’ve listed.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: Is Uday Chopra still an A-list Bollywood actor?
Answer: Come now, you’re just trolling the poor guy with your question. Uday Chopra was never an A-list Bollywood actor. Yes, he’s appeared in some blockbusters, but that was because of his familial connections. It does help when your dad is Yash Chopra, and your brother is Aditya Chopra. But he didn’t benefit that much from his connections - while he had a decent career of sorts, thanks to the Dhoom series, on the whole, his career as an actor could hardly be said to be A-list. He does seem to be trolled heavily by his detractors for benefiting from nepotism, which is something I’ve never understood. I mean, okay, he benefited from his familial connections - but how is that his fault? Everyone and their uncle in this world benefits from their familial connections, so why signal out just movie folks? Anyway, while Uday Chopra is not and never was an A-list Bollywood actor, he was decent enough in the Dhoom series as the lovable Ali.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: Why is yesterday's famous producer director Subhash Ghai not making or directing any film now? Is he facing financial problems?
Answer: Subhash Ghai simply became too outdated for the market, and his offerings all seem to be rather stale now. He was certainly in top form during the late 80’s and early 90’s, but by the time the 00’s came around, his products were definitely out of sync with current times. I think the disastrous reception towards Yaadein signaled the beginning of the end. Consider that after Yaadein, Subhash Ghai has only directed the following turkeys - Kisna: The Warrior Poet, Black & White, Yuvraaj, and Kaanchi. I suppose he has realized that his career as a director is over now. He will find it impossible to get any of the newer marketable stars in his films (with the exception of maybe Tiger Shroff, who may be susceptible to a spot of emotional blackmail). As a producer, he’s had a bit more success, since the 2000s, with Aitraaz and more recently Double Di Trouble. But his glory days are long gone, and I doubt he will be making or directing any more movies now. I don’t think he has any financial problems - he must have made enough money to live comfortably.

Name: Aditya Simha
Question: What is your review of the 2021 Bollywood movie Tadap? Is it better than the RX100 Telugu movie?
Answer: I don’t know about better - but it is definitely glossier than RX 100 was. The production values are higher, and everyone (i.e. producer, director, etc) has certainly done all they can to launch Ahan in a big way. Kartikeya did not quite have the same grand launch that Ahan has gotten. The story is pretty much the same, and the performances are all around decent. Saurabh Shukla is just splendid, as is Kumud Mishra. Ahan is decent, and Tara Sutaria is sultry with a sizzle! I did not think the Hindi cast did significantly better or worse than did the Telugu cast - pretty similar. I will say though that Payal Rajput carried off her role with a tad bit more sultriness than did Tara Sutaria. I think people who are watching Tadap without having seen RX 100 will possibly have a more visceral reaction to the surprise twist in the film. Question: What are the worst movie titles of all time Indian cinema?
Answer: I think the worst movie titles of all are the ones that unfortunate movies from the South get, when they get dubbed into Hindi. Whoever renames them is obviously having a blast, coming up with cringe inducing idiotic titles, which convey absolutely nothing about the movie. Consider the sordid fate of these five decently budgeted Telugu and Tamil movies - Athadu, Badrinath, Rajapattai, Sakthi, and Mogudu. Their Hindi titles are an absolute mockery and travesty. Athadu becomes the inexplicably titled Cheetah The Power of One. Why Cheetah? With such a crappy title, this idiotic trend of naming dubbed movies with dumb titles, ought to have gone the way of the Dodo. But alas, that was not to be! Instead we got other dimwitted titles like Sangarsh Aur Vijay, Main Hoon Dada No 1, Ek Tha Soldier, and Mard Ki Zaban. There are many other titles, but these are some that are especially quite terrible. None of the titles make any sense whatsoever, and successfully convert what were A-level movies in their original language to some cringe inducing C-level movies. So, I think these dubbed marvels are some of the worst dubbed films of all time, but their terrible titles take us into a dark and grim reality!
